summary: A trigger condition reading real recruitment state (loyal_to_michael), and a small quest giving recruitment its first campaign consequence

coordination.notes: A deliberately small, low-risk contract chosen after two missteps this session (the island-network commit built on ungrounded content; a doc claimed a nonexistent 'Ayla'). Reads only state that already exists and is already tested (NamedPerson.loyal_to_michael, set by the real recruit_island_person verb), invents no geography, no character identity, and no new numbers beyond one resource grant using an already-declared resource (resource.provisions). Gives recruiting a companion its first campaign-level consequence: before this, recruit_island_person changed nothing but a boolean. Proven end to end through the real production and recruitment path (main_scenario_world, advance_island_tick until a woman is produced, approach_island_person, talk_island_person, recruit_island_person), not a synthetic fixture standing in for it, specifically because the island-network mistake was partly a failure to prove a mechanism against anything real. Does not touch Betty, the island network, sites, or factions doctrine -- those remain separate, larger decisions the owner has not resolved. No new saved state was introduced (the condition reads an existing field), so no new invalid_saved_* refusal was needed.
